summary: Laser, rail gun, relativistic and teleporter turrets implement their distinct server-authoritative armor, effect, beam and safe-destination rules.

authoritative_state: TurretHeadBlockEntity resolves ray damage, potion effects and teleport destinations.
TurretBaseBlockEntity resolves permissions, energy, ammunition and addon context.
BeamEffectPayload carries cosmetic state only after server resolution.

flows.purpose: Render a bounded cosmetic laser or rail beam after server damage resolution.
validation: Client only applies particles in its current loaded level.
The server chooses start, end and one of the declared beam colors.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All special turret outcomes work without renderer classes.

budgets.measurement: Fixed ordered candidate positions inspected around the turret base.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

steps: Fire Laser and Rail Gun at armored targets on a dedicated server.
Use Relativistic twice against the same group.
Block the Teleporter's preferred destination and fire it.
